title: Komadori Mofmof Parade

alternative_titles.ja: こまどり モフモフパレード

synopsis:
Stop-motion anime of the IDOLiSH7 franchise's Mofmof mini characters' Mofmof Parade (or MofPara for short) project.

Mofmof are fluffy creatures who live on a mysterious planet somewhere in space. From time to time, these idiosyncratic, curious creatures even try invading Earth.

(Source: ANN)
